The request describes an observed test failure—specifically a flaky test that passes locally but fails intermittently in CI. The debug skill explicitly owns "every existing failing or flaky test routes to debug, never testing, including a test that passes locally but fails intermittently in CI." The request aligns with debug's scope: reproduce errors, form and falsify competing hypotheses about environment-specific failures, repair root cause, and verify the fix. The testing skill explicitly excludes diagnosing observed test failures and CI-only flakes.

The routing catalog explicitly routes "every existing failing or flaky test" to debug, never testing, "including a test that passes locally but fails intermittently in CI." This request describes exactly that scenario: a test with observed CI-only flakiness. The debug skill owns reproducing errors, environment-specific failures, forming hypotheses, and repairing root cause.

The request asks to draft a gated Code handoff (executor prompt with delivery gates) that implements a ratified construct spec. author-execution-relay explicitly owns executor prompts and handoffs: "Executor prompts and handoffs only; every gated instruction sent to Code or another executor routes here… Use this skill to author an execution relay, implementation handoff, or session kickoff that delegates bounded file and git toil while reserving judgment and per-gate ratification for the operator." The description specifically states it applies "even when either uses GitHub Actions or delivery gates or starts from a construct spec," making it the correct choice for a gated handoff originating from a construct spec.

The request asks to draft a gated Code handoff, which is an executor prompt and implementation handoff sent to Code. The author-execution-relay skill explicitly owns "Executor prompts and handoffs only; every gated instruction sent to Code or another executor routes here" and cites "implementation handoff" as a primary use case. The construct spec is the input to the handoff; the skill delegates bounded implementation toil to the executor while reserving judgment for the operator.

The request asks to draft a gated Code handoff for an already-ratified construct spec. Author-execution-relay explicitly owns executor prompts, implementation handoffs, and every gated instruction sent to Code or another executor. The construct spec is implementation-complete, so the task routes to handoff authoring, not spec authoring or execution.
